source: https://arrival.gov.kh/e-arrival (e-Arrival submission form: date boxes, calendar range and field checks read from its front-end, 2026-10-15)

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Passport number from the photo page.

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: Use the Latin passport spelling. The e-Arrival has a surname box (optional) and a given-name box, both letters, digits and spaces only.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Month first: the e-Arrival date boxes use m/d/yyyy. It cannot be later than today.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

flight_number.label: Flight number
flight_number.help: Pick the airline from the e-Arrival list first; the flight-number box then takes digits only (K6 817 → 817).

errors.invalidFormat: Digits only — the airline code is picked separately

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: Month first (m/d/yyyy). The e-Arrival calendar offers today through 6 days ahead, by the server's date.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: The e-Arrival takes arrivals up to 6 days ahead — come back closer to the date
